state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 4 is closed, and Stage 5 (dates, relative time, lists) is next.** `format-numbers` (`extensions/intl/src/numbers.rs`) and `plural-categories` (`extensions/intl/src/plurals.rs`) are implemented. `plural_rules_agree_with_core_cldr_on_its_whole_roster` (`crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs`) runs and passes, so `Novis\Intl\PluralRules` agrees with `Core\Cldr` on every language of its roster. The languages ICU4X's compiled data has no plural rules for are CLDR 46 rule strings in `plurals.rs` (`CARDINAL`, `ORDINAL`), parsed through `icu_plurals`' `serde` feature, and `mo`, `sh` and `tl` are read as `ro`, `sr` and `fil`. The module doc owns the details. This added 51,173 bytes to the guest wasm (3,230,540 to 3,281,713).

The exports `format-date-times`, `format-dates`, `format-times`, `format-relative`, `format-lists`, `word-segments`, `sentence-segments`, `resolve-locales` and `negotiate` still return `runtime`. `extensions/intl/nvs/` has `Collator`, `NumberFormat` and `PluralRules` and none of the other job classes.

next.title: dates and times, relative time, lists
next.note: one file set: `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs`, a new `extensions/intl/src/dates.rs` (and `relative.rs` / `lists.rs` beside it), `extensions/intl/nvs/`, `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs`.

items.text: **Implement `format-date-times`, `format-dates` and `format-times`** over `icu_datetime`, from the local fields the host sends, with no time-zone database in the guest. Owned by ADR 0277 § 6 and § 9. The exports are at `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:164`, `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:172` and `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:180`. Write `extensions/intl/nvs/DateFormat.nvs`, which converts a `Core\Time` value to local fields. The tests `a_core_time_value_formats_in_its_zone_and_locale` and `the_guest_carries_no_time_zone_database` go in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:464`.

**Implement `format-relative` and `format-lists`** at `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:188` and `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:196` (relative time is in `icu_experimental`, list formatting in `icu_list`). Write `RelativeTime.nvs` and `ListFormat.nvs`. The tests are `relative_time_formats_past_and_future` and `a_list_formats_with_its_locale_conjunction`. Owned by ADR 0277 § 1 and § 9.

**Write the two Stage 5 cases**: `tests/conformance/novis/intl-dates-format-in-their-zone-and-locale.nvst` and `tests/conformance/novis/intl-relative-time-and-lists.nvst`. Use `tests/conformance/novis/intl-numbers-format-by-locale.nvst:1` as the shape.

backlog: Stage 7: each component's module doc states its embedded size, and a bundle calls both components (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/bundle.rs`).
Stage 8: the feature proofs for every `Novis\Intl` class (`bun nv proofs --owed`).
`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in` still says only `collateOrder` and `sortKeys` are implemented. Rewrite that sentence when Stage 5 lands.
